findings.label: Unrelated changes bundled in the feature commit
findings.detail: Commit b003df1 also contains the AppLensTrigger.tsx local-dev rework, AppLensModal.tsx, docs/DEVELOPER.md, Example/ metro/tsconfig/package changes, .vscode/settings.json, and a committed applens-react-native-0.3.2.tgz binary. None belong to the token-usage feature; split them out and do not track the build tarball.

findings.label: Fallback input estimate joins turns with newline only
findings.detail: The chars/4 fallback approximates input from systemPrompt + conversation.map(m => m.content).join('\n'), ignoring per-message role framing/overhead, so it reads low versus a real tokenizer. Acceptable: it runs only when the API omits usage and is explicitly marked estimated (~ prefix).
